name: EcoGenesis
tag: Lets you design and test a self-sustaining natural space on screen before you build it.

scenarios.title: Design a backyard food forest
scenarios.ask: Design a food forest on {area} in a {climate} climate. Show me year {years}.
steps: Layout
Placed canopy trees, shrubs, ground cover and vines in 7 layers across {area}.
Plant picker
Chose {=round(area / 6)} plants suited to a {climate} climate.
Simulator
Grew the design for {years} year(s), tracking shade, water use and soil.
Balance check
Flagged where shade will crowd out lower layers by year {=min(years, 4)}.

result.title: Design at year {years}
rows: About {=round(area * (4 - climate) * 2)} L/week in dry spells

followups: It is a planning model built on typical growth rates. Real growth depends on your soil and weather, so treat results as a guide.
Yes. Upload a site sketch or map and the layout uses your real shapes and sun angles.

scenarios.title: Balance an aquaponics loop
scenarios.ask: We have a {tank} fish tank. How many fish and how much grow bed keep it balanced?
steps: Fish model
At this stocking, the tank holds about {=round(tank / density)} kg of fish.
Feed
Fish eat about 1.5% of body weight: {=round(tank / density * 15)} grams of feed a day.
Plants
Matched {=round(tank / density * 15 / 60, 1)} square meters of grow bed to that feed.
Simulator
Ran 90 days and tracked ammonia, nitrate and oxygen.
followups: The model shows ammonia rising and oxygen falling within days, so you can see the risk before it happens in the tank.
Common warm and cool water species. Pick one and the feed and temperature numbers change to match.

scenarios.title: Plan a wildlife pond
scenarios.ask: Plan a {pond} pond with {plants} plant cover. Will it stay clear?
steps: Designer
Shaped shallow edges and one deeper zone of at least 0.8 m.
Plant picker
Chose submerged, floating and edge plants for {plants} cover.
Simulator
Tested a summer heat wave for algae and oxygen.
Wildlife
Added a sloped exit so animals can climb out.
followups: Many pond keepers aim for half to two-thirds plant cover to shade the water and starve algae. Move the slider to see the change.
Not always. The simulator shows whether a small solar pump would help oxygen on hot days.
